text: Live end-to-end verification of the FSM/caption/audio DOM selectors against a real authenticated Teams meeting. All browser selectors are marked VERIFY LIVE; run the integration harness (GO_TEAMS_INTEGRATION=1, TEAMS_PROFILE_DIR, TEAMS_MEETING_URL) and iterate on selectors/timing until TestMeetingJoin/EnableCaptions/CaptureAudio pass.

shine-mp3 unsafe/-race residual risk: its unsafe pointer arithmetic trips -race checkptr and is technically UB even in non-race builds. Contribute a checkptr-safe fix upstream or vendor/replace the MP3 encoder before production audio use. See docs/compound/build-errors/shine-mp3-race-checkptr.md.

fix(config): ci.yml pull_request paths-ignore (.backlogit, docs, .autoharness, *.md) means docs/backlog-only PRs never run the CI workflow, so the 'Detect code changes' job (the paths-filter detector) never reports. CURRENT CONTEXT (2026-07-10): operator set ruleset PR-Required required_status_checks=[], so this no longer BLOCKS merges today (backlog/docs PRs merge CLEAN). LATENT: if required checks are re-added, docs/backlog PRs would again leave the required check pending. Fix if/when required checks return: remove paths-ignore from the pull_request trigger so 'changes' always runs; the 'Build, vet, lint & test' job already self-gates via if needs.changes.outputs.code==true + the dorny/paths-filter denylist, so it stays skipped for backlog-only diffs. Low priority while required_checks=[].
